# llms.txt — Machine-readable summary of FractalBeats for AI crawlers
# https://llmstxt.org

## About
FractalBeats is a free, open-source, web-based audio-reactive visualizer.
It plays any audio (file upload or microphone) and renders real-time fractal
visualizations that pulse to the beat. Runs entirely in the browser via WebGL2 —
no install, no backend, no accounts.

## Homepage
https://navid-moradimehr.github.io/FractalBeats/

## Usage summary
Open the site, click "Load Audio" (or enable mic), then pick a visual screen.
Press space to play/pause, S for the screen picker, F for fullscreen.
Keyboard 1-4 switches screens. See README.md for full controls.
